capabilities: Patch global search, backlinks view and embedded queries with context trees
Build structural breadcrumbs from ancestor headings and list items above each match
Render match text from Markdown to HTML
Display sub-list items below a matched list item
Show the first section below a matched heading
extras: Warning: the plugin reaches into Obsidian's internals and may break after Obsidian updates, and requires a reload after install, update, enable or disable.
intentEvidence: It patches native search, backlinks view, embedded backlinks and embedded queries
problem: Obsidian's search and backlink results show bare match lines with no structural context, making it hard to see where a match sits in a document.

relations.evidence: Thanks to TFTHacker for his plugin, which helped me figure out how to implement a bunch of small improvements
Thanks to NothingIsLost for his awesome plugins, that helped me figure out how to patch Obsidian internals
Thanks to PJEby for his patching library

summary: Search enhancement plugin that decorates global search, backlinks and embedded queries with outliner-like breadcrumb context trees around each match.
